scope: Our benchmark is inference only: 128 shared paired VITON-HD test cases, eight released checkpoints, 1,024 outputs at 1024×768 on H200. No model was retrained for this comparison.
benchmark_caveat: We used a common OOTD-derived inpainting mask with remapped dataset parsing labels and supplied pose coordinates, while retaining each model’s required conditioning. Optional final RGB compositing was disabled. This is a controlled comparison with adapted inputs, not an exact reproduction of every paper’s evaluation.
metric: Molmo localizes components; frozen DINOv2 and our trained regional experts score generated versus GT features at shared GT-defined locations. Lower normalized expert L2 distance is better. These scores are not percentages, and automatic localization errors can affect them.

models.name: CORAL
models.train: Attention layers fine-tuned. Rectified-flow loss plus DINOv3 correspondence distillation and attention entropy loss (weights 0.01 and 0.1). Cycle consistency filters unreliable teacher matches.
models.data: Separate VITON-HD and DressCode models; our checkpoint is VITON-HD.
models.condition: Garment/person canvas + inpaint mask; DensePose tokens with shared person/pose spatial positions; fixed text prompt. Person queries attend garment keys in joint attention.
models.note: DINOv3 supplies training correspondences, not our benchmark score.
models.routing: DensePose with upstream hair-color adjustment; fixed paired-image prompt.

models.name: DeCo-VTON
models.train: Full UNet fine-tuning. Person-only DREAM-rectified noise loss; remove garment information from the unconditional branch; replace garment state using clean-latent anchoring during inference.
models.schedule: Published 512×384 recipe: 16k / 32k steps (VITON-HD / DressCode); batch 128; AdamW, 1e−5; 2×H200; BF16.
models.condition: Masked person + garment latents stacked spatially, with inpaint mask. Self-attention connects both regions. No text or pose-map input to the denoiser.
models.note: We evaluated the released 1024 checkpoint. Its specific training schedule is not established by the paper’s 512-resolution recipe.
models.routing: DDIM, eta=1; latent concatenation; lookahead garment disabled.

models.name: FastFit-SR
models.train: Noise-predicting diffusion model with learned reference-class embeddings and asymmetric attention. Exact trainable subset and complete loss recipe are not specified in the cited paper.
models.data: Single-reference model trained on VITON-HD + DressCode. Separate MR version adds DressCode-MR fine-tuning; we evaluated SR.
models.schedule: 1024×768; SR 64k steps; batch 32; AdamW, 1e−5; 8×H100; 20% reference dropout. MR adds 16k steps.
models.condition: Masked person composited with DWPose + mask. Garment latents use class embeddings instead of timesteps; target attends all tokens, references attend only themselves. Reference K/V cached once.
models.note: Our run uses one upper-body reference, class ID 0.
models.routing: Author DWPose utility; one reference; eager VAE rather than compilation.

models.name: LeFFA
models.base: SD1.5 inpainting; reference UNet + generative UNet.
models.train: Both UNets fully trainable. Diffusion noise loss, then attention-derived flow/warp reconstruction loss (weight 1e−3); alignment restricted to t<500 and higher-resolution attention.
models.data: VITON-HD checkpoint evaluated; separate DressCode model released.
models.schedule: 512×384: 10k steps, batch 256 → 1024×768: 36k, batch 64 → 10k with LeFFA loss. AdamW, 1e−5 throughout.
models.condition: Masked person, mask and DensePose; clean garment through reference UNet. Target/reference features concatenate inside self-attention. Text cross-attention removed; no CLIP garment encoder.
models.note: The paper’s alignment loss does not claim reliable detail coordinates at every noise level.

models.name: CatVTON-FLUX alpha
models.train: Fine-tuned transformer; released training code uses a flow-matching objective. Exact alpha checkpoint recipe is not documented. Despite “full parameter” wording in the README, the pinned script selects attention parameters.
models.schedule: Alpha-specific steps, batch and training resolution: unverified. Public launch script: 768×576, batch 1/device, accumulation 8, AdamW 2e−5, 100k-step cap. This is not an alpha training receipt.
models.condition: Garment and masked person side by side + combined inpaint mask; joint transformer attention; fixed paired-image text prompt. No explicit pose-map input.
models.note: Not the CatVTON authors’ separate FLUX LoRA. Our loader uses FLUX.1-dev supporting components with the alpha Fill transformer.
models.routing: Full alpha transformer; no LoRA; fixed paired-image prompt.

models.name: CatVTON
models.train: Only self-attention trained (49.57M parameters); text cross-attention omitted. DREAM diffusion training with λ=10; remaining backbone frozen.
models.data: Separate VITON-HD and DressCode benchmark models. We use the VITON-HD-specific weights.
models.schedule: 512×384; 16k steps; batch 128; AdamW, 1e−5; 8×A800. Separate multitask 1024 recipe is not the checkpoint evaluated here.
models.condition: Spatially concatenate person and garment latents with masked-person/mask conditioning. Garment transfer through self-attention. No text, CLIP reference encoder or explicit pose input.
models.note: 512-trained attention checkpoint run at 1024×768, as supported by its inference pipeline.
models.routing: VITON-HD 16k/512 attention weights; native inference at 1024×768.

models.name: IDM-VTON
models.base: SDXL inpainting TryonNet + SDXL GarmentNet + IP-Adapter.
models.train: TryonNet and IP-Adapter trained with denoising supervision. GarmentNet, CLIP encoders and VAE frozen. Optional per-garment customization is a separate stage, unused here.
models.schedule: 1024×768; 130 epochs; batch 24; Adam, 1e−5. Optional customization: 100 steps at 1e−6, not our benchmark.
models.condition: 13-channel input: noisy latent, masked-person latent, mask, DensePose latent. GarmentNet features join self-attention; CLIP/IP-Adapter garment features and detailed garment captions enter cross-attention.
models.note: Our run uses the supplied VITON-HD garment tags and the released checkpoint without customization.
models.routing: Native DensePose + garment tags/captions; FP16; no customization.

models.name: OOTDiffusion-HD
models.train: Both UNets jointly fine-tuned with noise-prediction MSE. Outfitting dropout enables garment classifier-free guidance.
models.data: Separate VITON-HD half-body and DressCode full-body models; we evaluated VITON-HD HD.
models.schedule: 1024×768 HD: 36k iterations; batch 16; AdamW, 5e−5; one A100. The 512 model uses batch 64.
models.condition: Garment UNet runs once at fixed t=0; its spatial features fuse via self-attention. CLIP garment embedding supplies cross-attention. Masked-person latent joins noisy target. Pose/parsing construct the mask, not an explicit pose input to the denoiser.
models.note: Category text is used by the full-body variant; our half-body variant uses the CLIP garment token.
models.routing: HD checkpoint-36000; UniPC; garment guidance 2; FP16.
